_comment: E2E (manual, live): same SheetExists collision check as gsheets_collision_envelope_e2e.json (QW1 >26-col headers + QW3 last_modified) but against an OPERATOR-PROVIDED existing spreadsheet (no creation). Uses a unique tab name per run so the seed write never pre-collides; the second write triggers the structured SheetExists error. Auth: OAuth user-scoped, injected in-memory.

test_payload.prompt:
Work ONLY on the EXISTING spreadsheet with id <YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID>. DO NOT create a new spreadsheet. The target tab name is 'WideE2E_RUNTAG' (it does NOT exist yet — it is unique to this run). HARD RULES: you may ONLY use gsheets_list_sheets and gsheets_run_python. You are FORBIDDEN from calling gsheets_add_sheet or gsheets_set_range. The tab must be created exclusively by the gsheets_run_python output_sheets write so its column grid matches the data width. Steps, in order:
1. Call gsheets_list_sheets to find any existing tab title; remember the first one as your bind anchor.
2. Call gsheets_run_python ONCE. Bind the existing anchor tab from step 1 as var `anchor`. In the code, build a pandas DataFrame `df` with EXACTLY 30 columns named c0..c29 and 3 data rows of real values, then set a code-level `output_sheets = {'WideE2E_RUNTAG': df}` (NO mode key — plain create). Set write_to_spreadsheet to <YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID>. Because 'WideE2E_RUNTAG' does not exist, this creates it with all 30 columns of data — no collision.
3. Call gsheets_run_python AGAIN. Bind the now-existing 'WideE2E_RUNTAG' tab as var `w`. Build any small `df2` and set `output_sheets = {'WideE2E_RUNTAG': df2}`. Do NOT pass on_existing_sheet / mode — use the DEFAULT policy. This MUST collide and return a SheetExists error.
4. Report the EXACT step-3 tool result, especially wrote_sheets[0]: its `error`, the FULL `current_state.columns` list, `current_state.n_cols`, and `current_state.last_modified`. Paste the structured fields verbatim — do not summarize.

config.system_message: You are a precise data engineer testing a Google Sheets integration against an existing operator spreadsheet. Never create a new spreadsheet. Follow the numbered steps EXACTLY and in order. When a tool returns a structured error envelope, report its fields verbatim — that envelope is the point of the test. output_sheets is a code-level variable your Python assigns inside gsheets_run_python, never a tool argument.
